description: Habitat assignment via LLM, spatial QAQC, consensus habitat

functions.name: build_habitat_prompt
functions.description: Build hierarchical LLM prompt for habitat assignment of taxa

inputs.name: taxon_list
inputs.description: Non-empty vector of scientific names to classify

inputs.name: extra_covariates
inputs.description: Additional covariate columns to request alongside the habitat classification

inputs.name: chunk_size
inputs.description: Taxa per LLM call

inputs.name: habitat_scheme
inputs.description: Habitat classification scheme to use (default IUCN Habitats Classification Scheme)

inputs.name: geographic_context
inputs.description: Free-text geographic context to include in the prompt

functions.name: parse_hierarchical_habitat_response
functions.description: Parse LLM habitat response into wide data frame with habitat weight columns

inputs.name: raw_text
inputs.description: Length-1 non-empty raw LLM response text to parse

inputs.name: taxon_list
inputs.description: The same taxon_list passed to build_habitat_prompt(), used to validate/align parsed rows

inputs.name: habitat_scheme
inputs.description: Must match the scheme used in build_habitat_prompt()

inputs.name: extra_covariates
inputs.description: Must match the extra_covariates used in build_habitat_prompt()

output.description: Wide data frame: one row per taxon, habitat weight columns

functions.name: build_habitat_lookup
functions.description: Cached one-call habitat classification: build_habitat_prompt() -> prompt_api() -> parse_hierarchical_habitat_response(), asking the LLM only about taxa not already classified under the same scheme (per-taxon on-disk cache). Returns the habitats_df that assign_habitat_biological() consumes.

inputs.name: taxon_list
inputs.description: Non-empty vector of scientific names to classify

inputs.name: habitat_scheme
inputs.description: Passed to build_habitat_prompt(): NULL (three-realm default), "IUCN_L1", or a scheme data frame

inputs.name: llm_fn
inputs.description: LLM provider function, as for TaxaTools::prompt_api()

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Per-taxon cache directory; NULL disables caching. Workflows pass file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(OUT_PREFIX, "_habitat_cache"))

inputs.name: extra_covariates
inputs.description: Passed to build_habitat_prompt()

inputs.name: chunk_size
inputs.description: Taxa per LLM call

inputs.name: geographic_context
inputs.description: Passed to build_habitat_prompt()

inputs.name: cache_tag
inputs.description: Free-text component of the cache key; change it (e.g. to a model name) to force fresh verdicts

output.description: Wide data frame, one row per taxon in taxon_list order, with a cache_summary attribute (n_total, n_from_cache, n_called, n_cached_new)

functions.scaling_note: One LLM call per chunk of uncached taxa; zero calls on a full cache hit

functions.name: assign_habitat_biological
functions.description: Assign habitat classifications from pre-computed habitat weight table to spatial data

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Spatial data with point_id and taxon columns

inputs.name: habitats_df
inputs.description: Per-species habitat weights from parse_hierarchical_habitat_response()

inputs.name: habitat_cols
inputs.description: Habitat column names (auto-detected if NULL)

inputs.name: point_id_col
inputs.description: Column with spatial point IDs

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Column with taxon names

output.description: Input with main_habitat column added per point

functions.name: consensus_habitat
functions.description: Assemblage-level consensus habitat from per-species weights

inputs.name: habitats_df
inputs.description: Per-species habitat weight table

inputs.name: habitat_cols
inputs.description: Habitat columns (auto-detected if NULL)

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon name column

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Minimum weight for inclusion

functions.name: flag_institution_candidates
functions.description: Classification stage (pure, no interaction, no removal) for filter_gbif_quality()'s institution_flag column -- tiers flagged records by crossing the matched institution's real type (Herbarium/Botanic_garden/Zoo/Museum/University/Research_centre) against the record's kingdom. Mirrors flag_habitat_inconsistencies()'s classify-then-review pattern

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Output of filter_gbif_quality() -- must have institution_flag and institution_type columns

inputs.name: kingdom_col
inputs.description: Column with the record's kingdom

inputs.name: suspicion_rules
inputs.description: Optional custom institution-type-x-kingdom suspicion rules; NULL uses the built-in defaults

output.description: Input with one additional column, institution_suspicion: 'high'/'low'/'ambiguous' for a flagged record (institution_flag = TRUE); NA for every other record (never conflates 'not evaluated' with a real category)

functions.name: flag_habitat_inconsistencies
functions.description: For each unique occurrence point, derives the physical spatial zone (inland, coastal, marine shallow/deep/abyssal) using vector land polygons and NOAA bathymetry, and flags points whose recorded habitat is spatially inconsistent with that zone.

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Typically occurrences_with_habitat from the TaxaExpect workflow. Must contain latitude, longitude, and habitat columns

inputs.name: lat_col
inputs.description: Latitude column name

inputs.name: lon_col
inputs.description: Longitude column name

inputs.name: habitat_col
inputs.description: Habitat assignment column name

inputs.name: coast_buffer_m
inputs.description: Buffer distance (metres) around coastlines for habitat classification -- points within this buffer are not flagged as marine/freshwater inconsistencies (accounts for GPS uncertainty, tidal zones, coastal gradients)

inputs.name: marine_questionable_km
inputs.description: If > 0, marine species within this distance (km) of the coastline are flagged 'questionable' rather than 'likely'. 0 (default) disables this

inputs.name: depth_neritic_m
inputs.description: Depth threshold (metres) defining the neritic (continental shelf) zone

inputs.name: depth_oceanic_m
inputs.description: Depth threshold (metres) defining the bathyal/abyssal boundary

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Bathymetry resolution in arc-minutes for the NOAA GEBCO download; used only for depth classification of confirmed marine points

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Print progress messages

inputs.name: habitat_scheme
inputs.description: Optional habitat_prompt object or habitat scheme dataframe used to resolve habitat names for depth/distance checks. NULL relies on habitat_col values directly

output.description: occurrence_data with elevation_m (GEBCO value, diagnostic only), dist_to_coast_km, spatial_flag ('likely'/'questionable'/'unlikely'), spatial_flag_reason (plain-English explanation with numeric context) added

functions.scaling_note: One-time NOAA bathymetry download per bbox, then vectorised per-point classification; fast after the download

functions.name: review_spatial_flags
functions.description: Opens a Shiny gadget for reviewing/correcting the spatial_flag column added by flag_habitat_inconsistencies(). Points are shown in three views (Likely/Questionable/Unlikely) with a map for reassigning habitat or overriding the flag.

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Output of flag_habitat_inconsistencies(). Must contain spatial_flag, spatial_flag_reason, point_id, and coordinate columns

inputs.name: habitat_col
inputs.description: Habitat column for point colouring

inputs.name: lat_col
inputs.description: Latitude column

inputs.name: lon_col
inputs.description: Longitude column

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon column for the Point Info species display

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Named vector mapping habitat labels to colours. NULL uses the standard ecological palette

inputs.name: tile
inputs.description: Leaflet tile provider

inputs.name: point_radius
inputs.description: Circle marker radius in pixels

inputs.name: viewer
inputs.description: Shiny viewer function passed to shiny::runGadget(). Some RStudio configurations silently swallow leaflet-map clicks inside the Viewer pane -- pass shiny::browserViewer() as a workaround if map clicks appear unresponsive

output.description: Input occurrence_data with spatial_flag, spatial_flag_reason, and main_habitat updated where changed. Returns NULL if the user clicks Cancel

functions.scaling_note: Interactive; time depends on the reviewer, not data size

functions.name: save_spatial_review_decisions
functions.description: Extracts one row per point_id from review_spatial_flags()'s output (the reviewed spatial_flag and main_habitat) and merges it into a persistent decisions file at path, so a reviewer's decisions survive a later re-run of the automatic classifier.

inputs.name: reviewed
inputs.description: Data frame returned by review_spatial_flags() (must carry point_id, spatial_flag, main_habitat)

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The .rds decisions file, one per site

inputs.name: before
inputs.description: Optional: the table the gadget was opened on (flag_habitat_inconsistencies()'s output). When supplied, a point's habitat is recorded as a reviewer REASSIGNMENT only where it differs from before. Without before, EVERY non-NA main_habitat in reviewed is recorded as a reassignment (the conservative reading) and will be re-applied verbatim on every later run -- pass before whenever the pre-review table is available

inputs.name: point_id_col
inputs.description: Column name, matching review_spatial_flags()'s output

inputs.name: flag_col
inputs.description: Column name, matching review_spatial_flags()'s output

inputs.name: habitat_col
inputs.description: Column name, matching review_spatial_flags()'s output

output.description: Invisibly, the merged decisions table: point_id, spatial_flag, main_habitat, habitat_reassigned, decided_at

functions.name: apply_spatial_review_decisions
functions.description: Overwrites spatial_flag on every row whose point_id has a saved decision (and main_habitat where the decision was a reviewer reassignment), before (or instead of) re-opening the review_spatial_flags() gadget -- lets a saved review persist across re-runs.

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Output of flag_habitat_inconsistencies() (carries point_id, spatial_flag, spatial_flag_reason, main_habitat)

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The decisions file written by save_spatial_review_decisions()

inputs.name: point_id_col
inputs.description: Column name

inputs.name: flag_col
inputs.description: Column name

inputs.name: reason_col
inputs.description: Column name

inputs.name: habitat_col
inputs.description: Column name

output.description: occurrence_data with decisions applied. Attributes n_applied (rows changed), n_pending_review (distinct points whose flag is not 'likely' and carry no decision), pending_point_ids

functions.scaling_note: Fast; small file read + vectorised join

functions.description: Build a Habitat Scheme from the IUCN Red List Classification

inputs.description: Character, "all", or "none". Which Level 1 groups to include in the scheme. "all" (default) includes all L1 groups in the selected realm as single-level categories. inputs.description: Character, "all", or "none". Which Level 2 subcategories to include. "none" (default) produces a single-level scheme using only L1 group names. "all" adds all L2 subcategories under the selected L1 groups. A character vector of specific L2 names adds only those subcategories; their L1 parent groups

functions.name: report_habitat
functions.description: Generate a Report Section for Habitat Assignment

inputs.name: habitat_data
inputs.description: Data frame. Output of assign_habitat_biological or the raw habitat weights from parse_hierarchical_habitat_response. Must contain at least one numeric habitat weight column.

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Character. Column name containing taxon names. Default "scientificName".

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Logical. Print summary messages. Default FALSE.

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: A dataframe, typically the output of flag_institution_candidates. Must contain institution_flag, institution_suspicion, institution_name, institution_type, institution_dist_m, institution_lon, institution_lat, and coordinate columns.

inputs.name: lat_col
inputs.description: Character. The record's own coordinate columns (not the institution's). Default "decimalLatitude"/ "decimalLongitude" (GBIF standard names).

inputs.name: lon_col
inputs.description: Character. The record's own coordinate columns (not the institution's). Default "decimalLatitude"/ "decimalLongitude" (GBIF standard names).

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Character or NULL. Column for the species label shown in tooltips. Default "species".

inputs.name: tile
inputs.description: Character. Leaflet tile provider. Default "Esri.OceanBasemap".

inputs.name: point_radius
inputs.description: Numeric. Base circle marker radius in pixels. Occurrence markers are drawn at point_radius * 0.75; institution reference markers at point_radius * 0.5 (smaller and a distinct blue, so they provide spatial context without obscuring nearby occurrence points). Default 7.

functions.name: taxahabitat_clear_cache
functions.description: Report and clear TaxaHabitat's on-disk habitat-verdict cache

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Character. The directory passed to build_habitat_lookup()'s cache_dir. Defaults to tools::R_user_dir("TaxaHabitat", "cache"), matching the sibling packages; workflows that pass a project-local directory should pass the same one here.

inputs.name: older_than_days
inputs.description: Optional numeric. Delete only entries older than this many days. NULL (default) considers every entry.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Logical. TRUE reports what would be deleted without deleting it.
